info.title: DopaFit API
info.description: Contract-first API for the DopaFit fitness app.

ParameterSeries.description:
One anthropometry series.

A series is either a standard body parameter (``parameter`` set, the standard
``BodyParameter`` enum) or a user-defined custom field (``custom_slot`` set, with
the field's ``name``/``unit`` so the client can label the chart). Exactly one of
``parameter``/``custom_slot`` is populated; the other stays null. This keeps a
single response shape and one endpoint for both kinds (B010).

AccountRole.description:
User account role. Kept in the shared schema module so every DTO (auth, users,
link-requests) references the same enum without creating circular imports between
schema modules.

AddExerciseToProgramRequest.description: Add an exercise from the catalog to a program day (screen 22.x).

new_password.description: 8–32 characters, at least one uppercase Latin letter, one lowercase Latin letter and one digit; additional characters allowed

birth_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); the age it implies must be between 10 and 120 years

delta.description: Change of this metric vs the average of the same metric across prior finished sessions with this exercise (kg). None when there is no prior history.

local_date.description: Client-local calendar date of the session, used for all day grouping (analytics, calendar auto-mark, week widget, dashboard). Falls back to the UTC date of started_at when omitted (older offline clients).

get.description:
List custom measurement field definitions.

Without *client_id* returns the authenticated user's own fields.
With *client_id* (a TrainerClient card UUID) returns the linked client's
fields; the caller must be the card's owning trainer and the card must have
a real linked account (stubs return an empty list).
Period logic is not applied — custom fields are configuration, not time-
stamped entities.
